relationships.subject: Teflon AF 2400
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrated the passivation of a PDMS surface with Teflon AF 2400 solution to be able to form a non-adhesive layer to CBD.

key_findings: Fluoropolymer (Teflon AF 2400) coating of PDMS microchannels increased recovered CBD signal about 15-35x and supported hCMEC/D3 culture.
